a: A pipeline (or module) the GPU refuses is still drawn with until the async error scope resolves, voiding whole submits
Every texture binding gets sampleType 'float' and every sampler gets 'filtering', whatever the WGSL declares
The WGSL id composite does not clamp the color-matrix alpha, while the color composite now does, so ids are claimed by a different alpha than the one drawn
b: A pipeline the GPU will refuse is set on the pass before the refusal arrives, voiding the whole submit
Reflection binds every non-sampler handle type as a filtering float `texture_2d`, and every sampler as `filtering`
`set('u_arr[i]', …)` with more than one element's numbers writes only element i, where GL writes from i onward
